name: zkvm_zisk
description: The ZisK platform: entry point and memory map

enable.note: The ZisK transpiler implements Zba, Zbb and Zbs natively (sh*add, rev8, andn, clz, bset, ...). Only with a compiler package that has the Zb lowering fixes (dotnet-riscv#9). Zicond waits for a ZisK release that decodes czero.

options.note: Elide the RA spill/reload and frame in leaf methods (dotnet-riscv patches 23 and 31). Sound only on a single-threaded deterministic guest with no GC thread suspension and no return-address hijacking.

Constant-size SequenceEqual as the csrrs 0x814 + addi x0 idiom that the ZisK ROM transpiler folds into one dma_xmemcmp step (patch 30). Real ZisK only: the simulator, SP1 and OpenVM do not know the idiom.
dotnet-riscv fixup perf-56: emit these libziskos P/Invokes as the single csrrs of the precompile (three-argument entries as csrrs + add x0), with no register kills. CSR numbers in hex.
dotnet-riscv fixup perf-57: code size is free on the zkVM and each avoided call saves its ABI overhead; +3 measured -2.2% steps for +3% code on mainnet blocks.
dotnet-riscv fixup perf-61: uGC never moves objects, so fixed locals need no pinning.
dotnet-riscv fixups perf-62/perf-63: synthesized block weights; locals live only across cold calls stay in caller-saved registers and are spilled at the call.
dotnet-riscv fixup perf-64: zero fills of 24+ bytes as the ZisK memset precompile idiom.
dotnet-riscv fixup perf-65: unrolled block copies of 16+ bytes as the ZisK DMA memcpy idiom.

The decoder has no C extension, and a single-threaded guest needs no atomics: the managed .text stays 32-bit and lock-free (dotnet-riscv fixups 24/25). Check with --error-on-compressed / --error-on-atomic.

Per-site inline allocation (dotnet-riscv fixup 26): the cell of the bump pointer, at a fixed address. It MUST equal g_zk_bump_ptr in the linker script. The top of the ZisK RAM window, which ends at 0xbffc0000 below the library RAM that ZisK 1.4 reserves.

args.note: Drops .eh_frame, .eh_frame_hdr and .dotnet_eh_table, which is exactly what the unwinder reads. Only when the build trades exception handling for size.
